Name: Item Bags for Rose and the Alchemist
Author: MsHakunaMatata
Description:
The answer is simple: enough room to keep all the findings the woods have to offer!

With Wildflour's permission, I have created several custom item bags for the incredible crops and forage from Rose and the Alchemist, and keeping in tune with both characters. 


[b][size=3]How do I obtain the Item Bags? [/size]
Requirements
[/b]You need to install:[list]
[*]Item Bags (and all its dependencies)
[*]Rose and the Alchemist (and all its dependencies)
[/list][size=2][i]This is not a mod in itself but a pack to use with item bags, it will not spawn the bags if you don't install both of these.[/i][/size]

[b]Installation[/b]
Just drag and drop the contents in the same folder where you've installed Item Bags and the bags will be saved in the corresponding folder.

[b]Buying the Bags[/b]
[list]
[*]They can all be bought at Pierre's Shop
[/list]
[b]
[size=2]Modded Item Bags Type note[/size][/b][size=2]
Seeds, Flowers and Fruit Bags will update automatically if the mod gets updated.
You'll notice the forage and mushroom ones have the old system. I hope to change this, but I haven't found what I want to do yet supported by Item Bags. Be on the lookout for an update. [/size][size=2]
[/size]
[b]Other plans[/b]
More add-ons will be on the way, always trying to bring some of the mod's own vibes to the bags. 
If you'd like to see some specific mods get their own add-ons, you can leave a post for me to consider.


[b]Thanks[/b]
Once again, to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1946434]SlayerDharok[/url], whose mod has been so useful for us players with a lot of crops, artisan goods and items.
And to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflourmods[/url] for the most magical mod creations we've seen this far. 
A lot of encouragement came from friends, they all know who they are and I'll always be thankful for you <3
